_comment: Player-facing node descriptions for the Skills tab (design/gdd/skill-tree.md 3.8-3.10). Keyed by node id; English and Thai. The node's own `text` in the class/race files is the designer's spec line and is never shown. Numbers mirror the node effects (placeholders until class_sim tunes them). logic/skill_tree_data.gd checks every node has an entry.

en.ss_t1_storm: Shield Rush also taunts every enemy within 3 m of the impact for 2 s.
en.ss_t1_riposte: Iron Guard lasts 4 s, and each counter fortifies you for 3 s.
en.ss_t1_blood: Intercept takes 55% of the blows meant for your ally instead of 40%.
en.ss_t1_flame: Breaker Slam reaches 4 m and slows the enemies it hits for 2 s.
en.ss_t2_storm_a: Shield Rush strikes again at 50% power. Cooldown +30%.
en.ss_t2_storm_b: Shield Rush knocks the enemy 3 m back and stuns it for 1.2 s. Damage -10%.
en.ss_t2_riposte_b: Iron Guard counters make the attacker bleed. Counter damage -10%.
en.ss_t2_blood_a: While Intercept links you, 30% of the damage you take for your ally hits the attacker back.
en.ss_t2_blood_b: The Intercept link lasts 9 s. Cooldown +20%.
en.ss_t2_flame_a: Breaker Slam's circle is 50% wider. Damage -20%.
en.ss_t2_flame_b: Breaker Slam is ready 25% sooner. Damage -15%.
en.ss_t3_a: Bulwark taunts every 6 s instead of 8, and you take 15% less damage while it holds.
en.ss_t3_b: Each Bulwark pulse fortifies allies within 4 m for 3 s.
en.ss_t4_a: While Bulwark holds, 25% of the damage you take is thrown back at the attacker.
en.ss_t4_b: You can no longer be stunned or knocked back, and Bulwark reaches 8 m.
en.gs_t1_slam: Crater Leap first drags enemies within 4 m of the landing spot 1.5 m inward.
en.gs_t1_eruption: Hook Sweep drags enemies 3 m from up to 6 m away.
en.gs_t2_slam_a: Crater Leap's landing hits a 50% wider circle. Damage -20%.
en.gs_t2_slam_b: Crater Leap sends a second shockwave 0.5 s later at 50% power.
en.gs_t2_shatter_a: Reaping Arc sweeps all the way around you. Damage -15%.
en.gs_t2_shatter_b: Reaping Arc sunders every enemy it hits for 3 s. Damage -10%.
en.gs_t2_eruption_a: Hook Sweep's cut is 50% wider. Damage -20%.
en.gs_t2_eruption_b: Hook Sweep's cut counts as a heavy hit and deals 30% more, but takes 40% longer.
en.gs_t2_cry_b: During Battle Trance, 20% of the melee damage you take hits the attacker back.
en.gs_t3_a: Cleave grows stronger: +20% per extra enemy hit, up to +60%.
en.gs_t3_b: A heavy that hits 3 or more enemies gives you haste and brings your next heavy one swing sooner.
en.gs_t4_a: Every heavy becomes a full circle sweep around you.
en.gs_t4_b: Nothing stops your skills or heavies, and each heavy heals 2% max HP per enemy hit (up to 8%).
en.lb_t1_pierce: Heartseeker flies through up to 3 more enemies and marks every enemy it hits.
en.lb_t1_trap: Vault Shot leaps 5 m and slows for 4 s.
en.lb_t1_lance: Pinning Shot pins the enemy for 2.25 s.
en.lb_t1_chain: Rapid Fire looses 5 arrows, and when its target falls the rest go to marked enemies first.
en.lb_t2_pierce_a: Heartseeker fires 2 extra arrows in a narrow cone. Damage -30%.
en.lb_t2_pierce_b: Heartseeker hits 50% harder but takes 60% longer to draw.
en.lb_t2_trap_a: Vault Shot leaves a puff of smoke that slows enemies within 2 m of where you jumped for 2 s.
en.lb_t2_trap_b: Vault Shot's arrow makes the enemy bleed and hits 20% harder.
en.lb_t2_lance_a: Pinning Shot flies through 2 more enemies and pins each. Damage -10%.
en.lb_t2_chain_a: Rapid Fire alternates between its target and the enemy nearest to it. Damage -15%.
en.lb_t2_chain_b: Rapid Fire's last arrow stuns for 0.5 s.
en.lb_t3_a: Hunter's Mark lasts 3 s longer and also weakens the target.
en.lb_t3_b: Your allies deal 10% more damage to marked enemies.
en.lb_t4_a: Every 4th shot at a marked enemy is a sure critical hit that pierces.
en.lb_t4_b: You keep enemies at 5 m, dodge more often, and your next skill after a dodge casts instantly.
en.mg_t1_fireball: Arcane Orb bursts in a 2.5 m circle.
en.mg_t1_ring: Repulse Nova throws enemies 3.5 m away.
en.mg_t1_strike: Starfall staggers enemies for 0.8 s (bosses still 0.3 s).
en.mg_t1_armor: Enemies that strike a veiled ally in melee are slowed for 2 s.
en.mg_t2_fireball_a: Arcane Orb throws 3 orbs in a cone. Damage -30%.
en.mg_t2_fireball_b: A second Arcane Orb follows 0.4 s later at 50% power.
en.mg_t2_ring_a: Repulse Nova bursts on the thickest pack within 7 m instead of around you. No push. Damage -10%.
en.mg_t2_ring_b: Repulse Nova is 30% smaller but hits 40% harder.
en.mg_t2_strike_a: Starfall hits a 50% wider circle. Damage -20%.
en.mg_t2_armor_b: A veiled ally hits melee attackers back for 25% of the damage they deal.
en.mg_t3_a: Every 3rd skill cast is free and deals 25% more damage.
en.mg_t3_b: A skill that hits 3 or more enemies makes your other skills ready 1 s sooner.
en.mg_t4_a: An enemy hit by 3 different spells within 4 s takes 40% more skill damage, and bursts if it dies like that.
en.mg_t4_b: When an enemy gets close you blink 5 m away and leave a Repulse Nova behind (every 6 s).
en.hu_1: Your Human passive is 25% stronger and comes back 25% sooner.
en.hu_2: Start every run with 40 ultimate gauge.
en.hu_3: After your ultimate, your next 2 skills cost no stamina.
en.hu_4: Your ultimate covers 30% more area and refreshes skills more.
en.hu_6: Skills crit 15% more often, and a skill crit makes that skill ready 1 s sooner.
en.hu_7: Each ultimate casts again 2 s later at half strength.
en.hu_8: Keep 35 gauge after your ultimate, and your passive is 25% stronger for 8 s.
en.vk_1: Your Viking passive kicks in earlier: its HP threshold is 10% higher.
en.vk_2: Each kill fills your ultimate gauge by 6 more.
en.vk_3: Your ultimate gains more power the more HP you have lost.
en.vk_4: Your ultimate heals you 3% max HP for each enemy it hits (up to 15%).
en.vk_5: Below half HP, your ultimate gauge fills 50% faster.
en.vk_6: Each kill heals you 2% max HP and makes your Rage and Haste last 2 s longer.
en.vk_7: Once per wave, a killing blow leaves you at 1 HP for 4 s with +50% ATK. Score a kill and you rise at 20% HP.
en.vk_8: Below 35% HP, your ultimate is ready at 60 gauge.
en.el_2: Healing your allies fills your ultimate gauge 50% faster.
en.el_3: Your ultimate heals 30% more and covers 25% more area.
en.el_4: Your healing on an ally below 30% HP also clears stun, slow and shock.
en.el_5: You heal yourself for 25% of the healing you give your allies.
en.el_6: Your ultimate leaves a grove for 4 s where allies heal 1.5% max HP per second.
en.el_7: Once per wave, the first ally to fall gets back up at 25% HP after 3 s, while you stand.
en.el_8: Overflowing healing jumps to the next most-hurt ally.
en.rb_1: Your Runeborn runes need one fewer charge to discharge.
en.rb_2: Each rune discharge fills your ultimate gauge by 8.
en.rb_4: Your ultimate is 25% stronger and its zones last 25% longer.
en.rb_5: After a discharge your runes start at 1 instead of 0.
en.rb_6: Your shields last 4 s longer, and a broken shield shocks enemies within 2 m.
en.rb_7: Runes can overcharge 2 past full; a fuller discharge hits harder.
en.rb_8: Each discharge gives every other Runeborn ally a rune.
en.combo_hu_ss: Every skill you cast brings Bulwark closer, and Rallying Drill returns every 6 s.
en.combo_hu_gs: A heavy that hits 3 or more enemies resets your quickest skill (every 4 s at most).
en.combo_hu_lb: Marked enemies take 20% more skill damage from the whole squad; Called Shot prefers a marked boss.
en.combo_hu_mg: Every 4th skill you cast fires a free second copy at 70% power.
en.combo_vk_ss: Below half HP, Bulwark reaches 3 m further and your hits weaken enemies.
en.combo_vk_gs: Cleave grows with the HP you have lost (up to +90%), and each kill keeps Ragnarok Whirl going longer.
en.combo_vk_lb: Each skill kill fires a free arrow at the weakest enemy (up to 3 per cast).
en.combo_vk_mg: Each skill kill heals 5% max HP, and below half HP your skills cover 20% more area.
en.combo_el_ss: While Bulwark holds, Warden's Grove heals every ally within 5 m.
en.combo_el_gs: While Living Bark is on, each extra enemy a heavy hits heals your most-hurt ally.
en.combo_el_lb: Moonlit Arrow comes every 3rd shot and roots marked enemies for 1 s.
en.combo_el_mg: Bloomcaster heals up to 12%, and its overflow becomes regeneration on that ally.
en.combo_rb_ss: Each Bulwark pulse gives a rune for every enemy it taunts (up to 3).
en.combo_rb_gs: Runic Edge counts as a heavy for Cleave and leaves a shocking field for 2 s.
en.combo_rb_lb: Each Glyph Shot discharge marks every enemy within 6 m of the target.
en.combo_rb_mg: Skills that hit 3 or more enemies give a rune, and Runeweaver's shields also bring focus.
